'''Humble Bundle''' is a {{Link|https://www.humblebundle.com/|website}} which raises money for charity by offering bargains on, among other things, books for limited periods of time.{{ref|{{Link|https://www.humblebundle.com/|humblebundle.com}}}}

==Robert Jordan's Wheel of Time==

From {{Date|2025-4-10}} through {{Date|2025-5-22}}, the {{Link |url=https://www.humblebundle.com/books/robert-jordans-wheel-time-books |text="Robert Jordan's Wheel of Time" Humble Bundle}} was available for purchase, with the {{Wiki|ACLU}} as the beneficiary. The bundle contained ebooks in the open-source, {{Wiki|Digital rights management|DRM}}-free {{Wiki|EPUB}} format:
